# Render and Rank
> Local search engineering, Google Maps 3-pack optimization, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO) for local service businesses.

## Overview
Render and Rank helps local service companies and multi-location businesses outrank competitors in Google Maps, local search results, and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, Claude).

- Website: https://renderandrank.com
- Founder: Omar Ali
- Core Services: Google Maps 3-Pack Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO), Local Citations & NAP Synchronization.
- Pricing: Published fixed rates ($149/mo, $249/mo, $349/mo). No long-term lock-in contracts.

## Key Capabilities & Methodology
1. **Google Maps 3-Pack Optimization**: Proximity calibration, Google Business Profile management, review generation workflows, and competitor spam suppression.
2. **AEO & Generative Engine Optimization**: Schema.org JSON-LD structuring (LocalBusiness, GeoCoordinates, FAQPage), Wikidata entity linkage, and AI knowledge graph syndication so LLMs recommend the business.
3. **Local Citations & NAP Consistency**: 100% synchronized business data across 70+ tier-1 and tier-2 registries with a transparent live spreadsheet.

## Free Tools & Diagnostics
- **AI Visibility Checker**: https://renderandrank.com/check — Test in real-time whether ChatGPT, Gemini, and AI assistants recommend your business in your city.
- **ROI & Lost Revenue Calculator**: https://renderandrank.com/calculator — Quantify the monthly inbound calls and revenue lost to competitors holding positions 1 to 3 in Maps and AI.
- **Free 24-Hour Geo-Grid Audit**: https://renderandrank.com/#free-audit — Custom geo-grid scan across your service radius delivered within one business day.
